label: false vein
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0025396 (phyllome lamina)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a vein-like strand of elongate, often thick-walled cells in a phyllome lamina (PO:0025396), not connected to the vascular system and without vascular tissue, as in many Hymenophyllaceae and some Pteridaceae.
reason: A real structure used by 3 floras (29 statements: present, absent, long, counted). It is not a leaf lamina vein (PO_0020138), which is vascular. PO has no class for it, so propose it to PO.

Narrower: the scales of a corona made of separate members are its divisions, which corona lobe defines as 'one of the divisions of a floral corona'. 'androecial corona scales' are staminal corona (FLOPO_0985022) members, which are still corona lobes.
French 'rang' means row or series. 'sur 2 rangs' or 'étamines sur 4 rangs' is a count of rows: an arrangement of the parts named in the same sentence, not a part itself.
Narrower: nervule (French nerville) means veinlet, the small higher-order veins. The previous review mapped veinlet to leaf lamina vein (C270), and this follows it.
Narrower: a lateral pinna is a pinna other than the terminal one. 'Lateral' is a position in the series, and the counts ('1-5 pairs') are pinna counts.

A generic outgrowth that needs the organ it sits on. The previous review rejected protuberance and projection the same way. 'with warts' is better annotated as PATO_0001361 warty on the bearing organ. Some 'white circular warts' on branchlets may be lenticels (PO_0000031), but that cannot be told without context.

Narrower, like the previous rule 'corolla upper lip' (C399). Apply it only when the statement falls under the corolla. Two-lipped calyces (Lamiaceae) and orchid descriptions also have an upper lip, so under the calyx it needs its own organ.

Narrower: in Iridaceae and Amaryllidaceae each spathe-valve is one bract of the spathe around the inflorescence. PO lists spathe as a synonym of inflorescence bract. FLOPO spathe (FLOPO_0986007) is the whole, aroid-type spathe, not one valve.

label: fruit beak
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009001 (fruit)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a narrowed, prolonged distal portion of a fruit (PO:0009001), often derived from the persistent style or the upper part of the ovary, as in the cypselas of Lactuceae, Cyperaceae achenes and Brassicaceae siliques.
reason: Floras give the beak its own length, hairs and shape (beak 7-9 mm long, strigose), so it is a distinct part, not just an apex region. Other floras use it too (Asteraceae, Brassicaceae, Cyperaceae, Geraniaceae). 'Achene beak' is then fruit beak part_of achene fruit (PO_0030107). PO has no class for it, so propose it to PO. The bare word 'beak' stays rejected.
'3 cell layers thick' and 'medulla a single cell layer' give a thickness counted in cells. It is a measure of the named part, not a part of its own.
Narrower: a pinnule of the second order of division in a more-than-bipinnate frond. Counts in pairs and shapes apply to it as a pinnule.
A fragment of a ratio statement ('palea 2/3 as long as lemma'). This is pattern 10 (ratio to another part), with lemma (PO_0009037) as the other part. It is not a part.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), adaxial side
reason: Moss leaf anatomy ('3-stratose with 6-9 large adaxial cells'). These are the cells on the adaxial side of the phyllid in cross-section. Express as plant cell part_of non-vascular leaf, with the adaxial surface qualifier from the context words. The counts are cell counts.
A fragment of ratio statements ('petals 1/3-2/3 as long as sepals'). This is pattern 10, with sepal (PO_0009031) as the other part.
Narrower: in the dimorphic strobili of Selaginella, the sporophylls of the ventral plane. 'Ventral' is a position in the series, kept as context.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006) part of corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017)
reason: One of the lobes of the lower corolla lip. Use pattern 12 (part of a qualified whole): corolla lobe part_of corolla lip. 'Lateral' is a position in the series.
A generic part that needs the organ it belongs to. It covers spadix appendix threads, filament-like appendages and fibres, and the examples do not say which.
A fragment of a compound count word ('3-6-nate at the lower nodes' = branches in whorls of 3-6). This is pattern 03 (count of parts) for branches per node.
The margin region of an existing class, using the surface/region pattern.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), region next to costa (PO_0030072)
reason: Moss leaf cells next to the costa. Express as plant cell part_of non-vascular leaf. The patterns have no 'next to costa' region, so keep that position in RDF. It is used only in bryophyte treatments, which is too narrow for a class.
In Asteraceae (Eupatorieae, Astereae) the appendage is the sterile far end of each style branch. Its length, shape and papillae can go on the apex region of style branch.

In Centaurea and relatives the appendage is the distal, often scarious part of the phyllary. Phyllary maps to involucral bract (C250), and this is its apex region. 'Middle phyllaries' is a position in the series.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), region base
reason: Moss terminology: cells of the leaf lamina at the leaf base. Express as plant cell part_of non-vascular leaf, base region. Qualities such as hyaline, rectangular and thin-walled go on the cell.
Ambiguous. French 'partitions pennatifides' are divisions of a parted leaf, 'cloisons saillantes' are septa, and 'partitions between the anther holes' are anther septa (PO_0005010). It needs context.
Narrower: in Melastomataceae, the stalk-like extension of the connective between the filament and the thecae. Its length, curvature and thickening are connective qualities.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), middle region; wall qualities
reason: Moss: the walls of the mid-leaf lamina cells. PO has no cell wall class in the lexicon, so put 'pitted' or 'incrassate' (thick-walled) on the cell. The 'medial' position stays in RDF.
The unopened corolla. Use pattern 12: corolla part_of flower bud. Shape and hair in bud ('narrowly ovate', 'inflated') are corolla qualities at the bud stage.
Scales on the blade (mostly ferns). PO lists scale as a synonym of trichome. Express as trichome part_of leaf lamina. Abaxial and adaxial come from the surface context words.
Moss capsule exothecial cells. Exothecium (sporangium epidermis) exists in PO, and its cells are expressed as plant cell part_of it.
Exact: the same class with the 'disk' spelling, which had no bearer rule.
